Chapter 384: Chapter 6: Smarter? I’ve Never Been Afraid of Anyone (Please Subscribe)_2

…

“Martial Path Evolutionary Path…”

Lin Yuan pondered for a while, opened the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, and checked the number of Evolvers at each stage.

“First Tier Chapter: 263,897.”

“Second Layer Chapter: 125,600.”

“Third Rank Chapter: 2,421.”

...

“Fourth Rank Chapter: 307.”

…

“It has grown so much?”

A smile spread across Lin Yuan’s face. Just the number of Evolvers at the first tier had reached more than 260,000, which meant that the unranked Martial Arts Evolvers might exceed one million.

Lin Yuan was very satisfied with this.

It is worth noting that the Martial Path Evolutionary Path had only appeared a few years ago. Being able to attract so many Evolvers to cultivate in such a short time was truly incredible.

“It must be those earlier released training videos that played no small part.”

Lin Yuan thought silently to himself.

Apart from the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, the cultivation analysis videos that broke into the Chikun Evolution Rankings and gained massive exposure must have also contributed significantly.

They could lower the threshold for Martial Arts cultivation a bit more.

“The analysis videos for the third and fourth rank chapters must not stop; whenever there’s time, let’s produce them.”

Lin Yuan made up his mind.

He then turned his gaze to the revenue share of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

“2,275 trillion?”

Lin Yuan was startled, and indeed, there were many zeroes following that figure.

“Most of this revenue comes from the sales of the Seventh Rank Chapter…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, his pricing for the Seventh Stage Martial Tao Chapter was 500 billion.

After uploading the Seventh Rank Chapter, it directly entered second place on the Chikun Evolution Rankings, pushing down two Eighth Layer Evolutionary Paths.

Countless Evolvers were curious about the Seventh Stage Martial Tao Chapter, and even if they did not cultivate it, buying it to watch was not an issue.

This was still in a comparatively short time, other Star Domains and the Star Alliance might not yet be aware of the number of Evolvers following the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

As time passes, the fame of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path would spread wider and wider, and Lin Yuan’s revenue share was about to see another surge.

“2,275 trillion…converted into Cosmic Currency, that’s 2,275 billion…which is 2,275 Cubic Cosmic Crystals…”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

The upload of the Seventh Rank Chapter turned the Martial Path Evolutionary Path into a golden goose, with each share of revenue bringing in thousands of Cubic Cosmic Crystals, equating to the total “fluid Cosmic Crystals” of a regular Eighth Layer Evolver.

In the future, if Lin Yuan could create the Eighth Layer Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, even Ninth Rank Evolvers might envy the wealth he possessed.

“With my current Cosmic Crystals, I could indeed purchase a few treasures to perfect my Inner World…” Lin Yuan silently thought to himself.

The Inner World, after all, was not a naturally derived world. Although it had a framework and nearly infinite potential for growth, in the early stages, Evolvers had to continually invest in it.

The investment here involved understanding the rules, as well as rare treasures to compensate for the deficiencies of the Inner World.

“Primordial Fire, which can bring bright flames to the Inner World, fostering the birth of Fire System Origin Rules…bought…”

“Essence of the Earth…bought…”

…

Lin Yuan, in one breath, bought several types of Rare Treasures, spending over ten thousand Cubic Universe Crystals before stopping.

“That should be enough.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the Cosmic Crystal balance in his account and immediately felt a pang of pain.

These Rare Treasures, capable of compensating for the deficiencies of the Inner World, were all extremely expensive, and even Lin Yuan was choosing them carefully.

“The cultivation of an Eighth Layer Evolver involves constantly perfecting the Inner World. The more complete the rules within the Inner World, the greater the benefits they offer to Eighth Layer Evolvers…”

“Teacher’s Inner World, I estimate, is no different from the real world…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, as his Inner World, though spanning over tens of thousands of miles, was still barren.

Having done all this.

Lin Yuan planned to continue pondering on how to swiftly enhance his own Spirit Will.

Just at that moment.

Chikun Star Lord sent a message.

“Come to me immediately.”

The tone of Chikun Star Lord was very serious.

“Hmm?”

“Could it be that something serious has happened?”

Lin Yuan looked puzzled but still immediately got up and headed towards the most majestic main peak on the Central Continent of Chikun Main Star.

…

Scarlet-red hall.

Chikun Star Lord was seated high above.

Lin Yuan and the other Peak Masters stood below.

“Teacher, what exactly is going on?” the Second Brother asked curiously.

“A significant matter,” Chikun Star Lord glanced at the Second Brother, looking towards the other Peak Masters, “this is a great opportunity for you.”

As Chikun Star Lord spoke, his gaze lingered on Lin Yuan for a moment.

“A great opportunity?”

“What great opportunity?”

“Teacher, could you clarify?”

The fellow brothers couldn’t help but ask.

Seeing this, Chikun Star Lord didn’t beat around the bush and straightforwardly said, “Recently, a Supreme Being of our human civilization fought against the Supreme Beings of several other races on a large alien battlefield and retrieved a part of a body.”

Upon hearing this.

The Peak Masters suddenly realized.

Recently, a corpse had drifted through the Eternal Spatial Rift located on the large alien battlefield.

The Insect Race, in their scheming for this corpse, had not hesitated to purge human Evolvers in some local battles.

This was to attract the gaze of the highest beings of human civilization, but obviously, the Insect Race’s scheme had failed as the top diviner of human civilization had noticed the corpse early on.

Even the Supreme Beings of the other peak clans had sensed it and had preemptively blocked the large alien battlefield.

The moment the corpse drifted in, several Supreme Beings attacked simultaneously.

Eventually, the corpse was torn apart, and the Supreme Beings of human civilization and those of other races each seized a part of the body.

“Teacher, do you mean our great opportunity is related to that segment of the body?” the Third Brother asked incredulously.

He had always thought that a body worth fighting over by Supreme Beings must be very important and had nothing to do with Evolvers like them, who were not even Eighth Rank.

Even Lin Yuan was somewhat curious, what kind of body could attract the attention of Supreme Beings?

“Indeed,”

Chikun Star Lord nodded.

“The Supreme Beings of our human civilization decided to select some Evolvers from each star domain to try to comprehend that part of the body.”

Chikun Star Lord spoke.

“Comprehend that part of the body?”

This statement made the Brothers’ pupils shrink slightly.

Although they did not know the exact level of the corpse that had entered the large alien battlefield.

Being contested over by several Supreme Beings likely placed it at the Supreme Being level as well.

A body of a Supreme Being? One should know, whether it was human Evolvers or the strong ones from other races, their flesh and blood contained the Dao and direction they pursued.

A body comparable to a Supreme Being represented a sky-reaching Great Dao to the Supreme level.

Even understanding just a little bit would be unprecedented help for them.

Afterward.

Chikun Star Lord advised some details and then let the Peak Masters go back to prepare.

“Teacher.”

Lin Yuan remained in place.

This was also Chikun Star Lord’s intention.

“That segment of the body is not so easy to comprehend. I don’t have much hope for your brothers; it’s merely going through the motions.”

Chikun Star Lord stated bluntly.

“But you…” Chikun Star Lord observed Lin Yuan carefully.

Lin Yuan’s talent was definitely the strongest he had ever seen, especially his intuitiveness in the aspect of Space Rules, unbelievably astounding, even more exaggerated than him, a Starry Sky Wanderer Kun.

However, intuitiveness… also has focal points.

Just like a genius who excels in math and physics may not do better than an average person in languages and geography.

Chikun Star Lord was certain, Lin Yuan’s intuitiveness in Space Rules was unbelievably high, but the force nature contained in that part of the body was not space.

“That part of the body is rather peculiar; if you sense something amiss, do not force it,” Chikun Star Lord specifically warned.

Even without that part of the body, Lin Yuan could still grow to the Eighth Layer, and possibly even strive for the Ninth Rank.

So in Chikun Star Lord’s view, Lin Yuan had more choices.

“I understand,”

Lin Yuan nodded.

He also asked another question, “Teacher, is comprehending that part of the body reliant on one’s own intuitiveness?”

“Yes, it requires an intuitiveness that matches that part of the body,”

Chikun Star Lord emphasized this.

“Understood,”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Since it depended on intuitiveness, he felt reassured.
